name: comp-593

frames.best_why: The calendar is open with a day chosen and the trigger shows the formatted range.

tagline: Reports header with a home breadcrumb, date range picker and filter buttons.
summary: A quiet dark toolbar with a home-icon breadcrumb ending in Reports, a date range field that opens a month calendar, plus Filters and Saved buttons on the right.
appearance: A dark header with a breadcrumb of a small home icon, a slash and the word Reports, then a date range trigger with a calendar icon, a Filters button and an outlined Saved button with a bookmark icon.
behaviour: Clicking the date field opens a monthly calendar; choosing a day fills the trigger with a formatted date range and closes the picker. Filters and Saved only react on hover in the clip.
demo_content: Breadcrumb reads Reports; the chosen range is Nov 18, 2026 - Nov 18, 2026 in a November 2026 calendar.
search_phrases: choose a date range from header
use_when: A reports page needs its date range and filters in a persistent top strip.
avoid_when: The Filters and Saved buttons have no wired behaviour here, so you must connect them yourself.
customise: The page title Reports is hardcoded; the date picker and filters are separate pieces configured in their own files.
weight_why: A breadcrumb, one date button and two small buttons.

a11y.note: Visible controls have names, including screen-reader text for the home icon; calendar internals live in a separate piece.

issues: The calendar popover is clipped at the bottom of the frames that show it.
polish_why: Clean, quiet report toolbar; the calendar is cut off by the crop.
